note: 系列 A 例句軌 B2 slice：自寫，待獨立 reviewer 審。

items.sentence: The old bridge was built more than a hundred years ago.
items.zh: 這座老橋是在一百多年前建造的。

items.sentence: She has been studying English for almost three years.
items.zh: 她學英文已經快三年了。

items.sentence: By the time we arrived, the show had already started.
items.zh: 我們到的時候，表演已經開始了。

items.sentence: Although the weather was cold, we enjoyed the long walk.
items.zh: 雖然天氣很冷，我們還是很享受這段長長的散步。

items.sentence: The movie was very long. However, it was never boring.
items.zh: 這部電影很長，不過一點也不無聊。

items.sentence: Despite the heavy rain, the match continued as planned.
items.zh: 儘管下著大雨，比賽還是照計畫進行。

items.sentence: My sister loves spicy food, whereas I prefer sweet snacks.
items.zh: 我姊姊喜歡吃辣的食物，而我比較喜歡甜的點心。

items.sentence: If I had known earlier, I would have helped you.
items.zh: 如果我早點知道，我就會幫你了。

items.sentence: Many people believe that technology makes our lives easier.
items.zh: 很多人相信科技讓我們的生活更輕鬆。

items.sentence: The report must be finished before the meeting on Monday.
items.zh: 這份報告必須在星期一開會前完成。

items.sentence: He has been working hard to improve his grades.
items.zh: 他一直很努力想提升自己的成績。

items.sentence: We had never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
items.zh: 我們以前從來沒看過這麼美的夕陽。

items.sentence: Even though she was tired, she kept practicing the song.
items.zh: 雖然她很累，還是不停地練習那首歌。

items.sentence: Recycling helps protect the environment for future generations.
items.zh: 回收有助於為未來的世代保護環境。

items.sentence: The new phone is being repaired at the local shop.
items.zh: 那支新手機正在附近的店裡維修。

items.sentence: If I were you, I would apologize to your friend.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會向你的朋友道歉。

items.sentence: Spending too much time online can affect your health.
items.zh: 花太多時間上網可能會影響你的健康。

items.sentence: The letters were delivered to the wrong address by mistake.
items.zh: 那些信件被誤送到了錯誤的地址。

items.sentence: She spoke so quietly that nobody could hear her clearly.
items.zh: 她說話太小聲，沒有人能聽清楚。

items.sentence: They have been living in that house since last summer.
items.zh: 他們從去年夏天起就一直住在那棟房子裡。

items.sentence: After he had saved enough money, he bought a bicycle.
items.zh: 他存夠了錢之後，就買了一輛腳踏車。

items.sentence: While some students prefer reading, others learn by listening.
items.zh: 有些學生偏好閱讀，有些則是透過聆聽來學習。

items.sentence: The problem could have been avoided with better planning.
items.zh: 只要有更好的規劃，這個問題原本是可以避免的。

items.sentence: Our teacher encouraged us to think before making decisions.
items.zh: 我們的老師鼓勵我們在做決定之前先思考。

items.sentence: Unless we leave now, we will miss the early train.
items.zh: 除非我們現在出發，不然就會錯過早班火車。

items.sentence: The museum, which opened last year, attracts many visitors.
items.zh: 這座去年開幕的博物館吸引了許多參觀者。

items.sentence: I wish I had spent more time with my grandparents.
items.zh: 我真希望以前能多花點時間陪我的祖父母。

items.sentence: Watching the news helps us understand world events better.
items.zh: 看新聞幫助我們更了解世界上發生的大事。

items.sentence: The bakery smells wonderful whenever fresh bread is being baked.
items.zh: 每當店裡正在烤新鮮麵包時，麵包店就飄出很棒的香味。

items.sentence: Reading every day has clearly improved my writing skills.
items.zh: 每天閱讀明顯提升了我的寫作能力。

items.sentence: The results of the survey will be announced next week.
items.zh: 這份問卷調查的結果將在下週公布。

items.sentence: Scientists have been warning us about climate change for decades.
items.zh: 科學家數十年來一直在警告我們氣候變遷的問題。

items.sentence: Although the task looked simple, it took us all afternoon.
items.zh: 雖然這項任務看起來很簡單，卻花了我們整個下午。

items.sentence: The streets had been cleaned long before the parade began.
items.zh: 在遊行開始之前，街道早就已經清掃乾淨了。

items.sentence: Most of our electricity is produced by burning coal and gas.
items.zh: 我們大部分的電力是靠燃燒煤炭和天然氣產生的。

items.sentence: However hard he tried, he could not solve the puzzle.
items.zh: 無論他多努力嘗試，都解不開這個謎題。

items.sentence: She had already left by the time I called her back.
items.zh: 等我回電給她時，她早就離開了。

items.sentence: Social media can spread both useful news and harmful rumors.
items.zh: 社群媒體既能傳播有用的消息，也會散播有害的謠言。

items.sentence: The patient was advised to rest for at least a week.
items.zh: 醫生建議這位病人至少休息一週。

items.sentence: Whereas my brother enjoys team sports, I prefer running alone.
items.zh: 我哥哥喜歡團隊運動，而我比較喜歡一個人跑步。

items.sentence: If she had caught the earlier bus, she would be home now.
items.zh: 如果她搭上了早一班的公車，現在就已經到家了。

items.sentence: A lot of plastic waste ends up in our oceans every year.
items.zh: 每年都有大量的塑膠垃圾最後流入我們的海洋。

items.sentence: The bridge has been closed since the storm damaged it.
items.zh: 自從暴風雨損壞了這座橋，它就一直封閉著。

items.sentence: Despite his busy schedule, he always finds time to volunteer.
items.zh: 儘管行程繁忙，他總是能抽出時間去當志工。

items.sentence: The documents were signed and sent back the same day.
items.zh: 這些文件在同一天就簽好並寄了回去。

items.sentence: I have been meaning to thank you for your kind help.
items.zh: 我一直想要謝謝你那麼熱心的幫忙。

items.sentence: Had they left earlier, they might have avoided the traffic.
items.zh: 要是他們早點出發，或許就能避開那場塞車。

items.sentence: Regular exercise is known to reduce stress and improve sleep.
items.zh: 大家都知道規律運動能減輕壓力並改善睡眠。

items.sentence: While the first plan failed, the second one worked perfectly.
items.zh: 第一個計畫失敗了，而第二個計畫卻運作得非常順利。

items.sentence: The children were being looked after by their grandmother.
items.zh: 這些孩子當時是由他們的奶奶照顧的。

items.sentence: Even though it was expensive, the trip was well worth it.
items.zh: 雖然這趟旅行很貴，卻完全值得。

items.sentence: Our town has changed a great deal over the past ten years.
items.zh: 過去十年來，我們的小鎮改變了很多。

items.sentence: The email was sent to the whole class by accident.
items.zh: 這封電子郵件不小心寄給了全班同學。

items.sentence: He speaks three languages, none of which he learned at school.
items.zh: 他會說三種語言，而且沒有一種是在學校學的。

items.sentence: If I were in charge, I would change the rules completely.
items.zh: 如果我負責這件事，我會把規則徹底改掉。

items.sentence: Many jobs that exist today did not exist twenty years ago.
items.zh: 許多現在存在的工作，在二十年前並不存在。

items.sentence: The windows are cleaned twice a year by a local company.
items.zh: 這些窗戶由一家當地公司每年清洗兩次。

items.sentence: She has been feeling much better since she changed her diet.
items.zh: 自從她改變了飲食習慣，就一直覺得身體好多了。

items.sentence: Nobody had expected the small team to win the final.
items.zh: 沒有人料到這支小隊伍會贏得決賽。

items.sentence: Reading online reviews can help you make a wiser choice.
items.zh: 閱讀網路評論能幫助你做出更明智的選擇。

items.sentence: Although we disagreed at first, we soon reached an agreement.
items.zh: 雖然我們起初意見不合，但很快就達成了共識。

items.sentence: The missing keys were found under a pile of papers.
items.zh: 那串不見的鑰匙在一疊紙底下被找到了。

items.sentence: He would have passed the exam if he had studied harder.
items.zh: 要是他複習得更認真，就會通過考試了。

items.sentence: Too much screen time before bed can harm your sleep.
items.zh: 睡前盯著螢幕太久可能會傷害你的睡眠。

items.sentence: The factory has been producing paper bags instead of plastic ones.
items.zh: 這間工廠一直改以生產紙袋來取代塑膠袋。

items.sentence: I would rather stay home tonight than go out in the rain.
items.zh: 今晚我寧願待在家裡，也不想冒著雨出門。

items.sentence: The announcement was made while we were still having lunch.
items.zh: 那則通知是在我們還在吃午餐的時候宣布的。

items.sentence: Not only did she apologize, but she also offered to help.
items.zh: 她不但道了歉，還主動提出要幫忙。

items.sentence: Had I known about the delay, I would have taken the train.
items.zh: 要是我早知道會誤點，我就會改搭火車了。

items.sentence: Public parks give city residents a quiet place to relax.
items.zh: 公園讓城市居民有個安靜的地方可以放鬆。

items.sentence: The report was reviewed carefully before it was finally approved.
items.zh: 這份報告在最終核准之前經過了仔細審查。

items.sentence: She could not sleep because she had drunk too much coffee.
items.zh: 她睡不著，因為她喝了太多咖啡。

items.sentence: The more I practice, the more confident I become on stage.
items.zh: 我練習得越多，在台上就越有自信。

items.sentence: Fresh vegetables are delivered to the market every morning.
items.zh: 新鮮的蔬菜每天早上都會送到市場。

items.sentence: Even if it rains tomorrow, the festival will still go ahead.
items.zh: 即使明天下雨，這場慶典還是會照常舉行。

items.sentence: They have been saving money so that they can travel abroad.
items.zh: 他們一直在存錢，為的是能夠出國旅行。

items.sentence: The old factory has been turned into an art gallery.
items.zh: 那間老工廠已經被改造成一間藝廊。

items.sentence: Honest feedback, though sometimes painful, helps us improve.
items.zh: 誠實的回饋雖然有時令人難受，卻能幫助我們進步。

items.sentence: By next June, I will have lived here for five years.
items.zh: 到明年六月，我就在這裡住滿五年了。

items.sentence: Spending time in nature has been shown to lift our mood.
items.zh: 研究顯示，待在大自然裡能提振我們的心情。

items.sentence: The new library has been open for three months now.
items.zh: 這座新圖書館到現在已經開放三個月了。

items.sentence: Although he apologized, she was still clearly upset with him.
items.zh: 雖然他道了歉，她顯然還是在生他的氣。

items.sentence: The data had been collected long before the study began.
items.zh: 這些資料早在研究開始之前就已經蒐集好了。

items.sentence: Clean water should be treated as a basic human right.
items.zh: 乾淨的水應該被視為一項基本人權。

items.sentence: Despite feeling nervous, she gave a confident presentation to the class.
items.zh: 儘管感到緊張，她還是向全班做了一場自信的報告。

items.sentence: My cousin prefers city life, whereas I enjoy the quiet countryside.
items.zh: 我表哥喜歡城市生活，而我喜歡安靜的鄉間。

items.sentence: If the alarm had worked, we would have woken up earlier.
items.zh: 如果鬧鐘有響，我們就會早點醒來了。

items.sentence: Experts say that daily reading strengthens a child's growing brain.
items.zh: 專家表示，每天閱讀能強化孩子發育中的大腦。

items.sentence: The broken window must be replaced before winter arrives.
items.zh: 這扇破掉的窗戶必須在冬天來臨前更換。

items.sentence: She has been volunteering at the shelter every weekend this year.
items.zh: 今年她每個週末都在收容所當志工。

items.sentence: We had barely finished dinner when the guests started to leave.
items.zh: 我們才剛吃完晚餐，客人就開始離開了。

items.sentence: Even though the directions were clear, they still got lost.
items.zh: 雖然指示很清楚，他們還是迷路了。

items.sentence: Planting more trees can slowly cool our warming cities.
items.zh: 多種樹木可以慢慢讓我們日益炎熱的城市降溫。

items.sentence: The stolen painting is being searched for by the police.
items.zh: 警方正在搜尋那幅被偷走的畫作。

items.sentence: If I had more free time, I would learn to paint.
items.zh: 如果我有更多空閒時間，我會去學畫畫。

items.sentence: Skipping breakfast regularly can lower your energy throughout the day.
items.zh: 經常不吃早餐會讓你整天精神不濟。

items.sentence: The package was left on the doorstep by the delivery driver.
items.zh: 那個包裹被送貨司機放在了門口台階上。

items.sentence: He worked so carefully that he hardly made any mistakes.
items.zh: 他工作得非常仔細，幾乎沒有犯什麼錯。

items.sentence: They have been building the new stadium since early spring.
items.zh: 他們從初春起就一直在興建這座新體育場。

items.sentence: Once she had packed her bags, she called for a taxi.
items.zh: 她把行李打包好之後，就叫了一輛計程車。

items.sentence: While some people fear new technology, others welcome it eagerly.
items.zh: 有些人害怕新科技，有些人則熱切地歡迎它。

items.sentence: The accident could have been prevented with a little more care.
items.zh: 只要再小心一點，這場意外原本是可以避免的。

items.sentence: Our coach reminded us to warm up before every practice.
items.zh: 我們的教練提醒我們每次練習前都要先暖身。

items.sentence: Unless the rain stops soon, the picnic will be canceled.
items.zh: 除非雨很快停下來，不然這場野餐就要取消了。

items.sentence: The hospital, which was rebuilt last year, now serves more patients.
items.zh: 這家去年重建的醫院，現在能服務更多病人。

items.sentence: I wish I had listened more carefully to my teacher's advice.
items.zh: 我真希望當初能更仔細聽老師的建議。

items.sentence: Checking facts carefully helps us avoid believing false stories online.
items.zh: 仔細查證有助於我們避免相信網路上的假消息。

items.sentence: The garden looks magical whenever the morning fog is lifting.
items.zh: 每當晨霧正在散去時，這座花園看起來就如夢似幻。

items.sentence: Writing a journal every night has calmed my restless mind.
items.zh: 每晚寫日記讓我浮躁的心情平靜了下來。

items.sentence: The winners of the contest will be chosen by three judges.
items.zh: 這場比賽的優勝者將由三位評審選出。

items.sentence: Doctors have been urging people to drink more water daily.
items.zh: 醫生一直在呼籲大家每天多喝水。

items.sentence: Although the recipe seemed difficult, the cake turned out perfectly.
items.zh: 雖然這份食譜看起來很難，蛋糕卻做得非常完美。

items.sentence: The streets had been decorated weeks before the holiday began.
items.zh: 在節慶開始的好幾週前，街道就已經布置好了。

items.sentence: Much of our food is grown on farms far from the city.
items.zh: 我們大部分的食物是在遠離城市的農場種出來的。

items.sentence: However carefully she drove, the old car kept breaking down.
items.zh: 無論她開得多小心，那輛老車還是一直拋錨。

items.sentence: The train had already pulled away when we reached the platform.
items.zh: 我們抵達月台時，火車已經開走了。

items.sentence: Smartphones can connect us with friends yet leave us feeling lonely.
items.zh: 智慧型手機能讓我們和朋友聯繫，卻也可能讓我們感到孤單。

items.sentence: The nurse was told to check on the patient every hour.
items.zh: 護理師被交代每個小時都要去探視這位病人。

items.sentence: Whereas video games can be fun, too many hours harm your eyes.
items.zh: 電玩雖然很有趣，但玩太久會傷害你的眼睛。

items.sentence: If the team had trained harder, they might be champions today.
items.zh: 如果這支隊伍當初訓練得更勤，今天也許就是冠軍了。

items.sentence: A huge amount of food is wasted in restaurants every day.
items.zh: 每天都有大量的食物在餐廳裡被浪費掉。

items.sentence: The road has been blocked since a tree fell across it.
items.zh: 自從一棵樹倒下橫在路上，這條路就一直被封住。

items.sentence: Despite her shyness, she made several new friends at camp.
items.zh: 儘管她很害羞，還是在營隊裡交到了幾個新朋友。

items.sentence: The forms were filled out and returned within a single hour.
items.zh: 這些表格在一個小時內就填好並交了回去。

items.sentence: I have been hoping to visit that museum for a long time.
items.zh: 我一直希望能去參觀那間博物館，已經想很久了。

items.sentence: Had we booked earlier, we would have found cheaper seats.
items.zh: 要是我們早點訂，就會找到比較便宜的座位了。

items.sentence: Daily stretching is believed to keep our joints healthy and flexible.
items.zh: 大家相信每天伸展能讓我們的關節保持健康又靈活。

items.sentence: While the morning was sunny, the afternoon turned gray and windy.
items.zh: 早上陽光普照，到了下午卻變得陰沉又颳風。

items.sentence: The injured bird was being cared for by a kind vet.
items.zh: 那隻受傷的鳥當時正由一位善心的獸醫照料。

items.sentence: Even though the ticket was cheap, the concert was amazing.
items.zh: 雖然這張票很便宜，演唱會卻精彩極了。

items.sentence: This neighborhood has grown much safer over the last few years.
items.zh: 過去這幾年，這個社區變得安全多了。

items.sentence: The message was posted to the wrong group by mistake.
items.zh: 這則訊息被誤發到了錯誤的群組裡。

items.sentence: She owns many books, most of which she has already read.
items.zh: 她擁有很多書，而且大部分她都已經讀過了。

items.sentence: If I were the mayor, I would build more bike lanes.
items.zh: 如果我是市長，我會多蓋一些自行車道。

items.sentence: Several tools we rely on today did not exist a decade ago.
items.zh: 許多我們現在依賴的工具，在十年前根本不存在。

items.sentence: The floors are polished every evening by the cleaning staff.
items.zh: 這些地板每天晚上都由清潔人員擦得發亮。

items.sentence: He has been sleeping better since he turned off his phone.
items.zh: 自從他把手機關機，睡眠就一直變得比較好。

items.sentence: Nobody had imagined that the quiet student would become a leader.
items.zh: 沒有人想像得到那個安靜的學生會成為領導者。

items.sentence: Comparing different sources helps you reach a fairer conclusion.
items.zh: 比較不同的來源能幫助你得出更公正的結論。

items.sentence: Although the plan was risky, it eventually paid off nicely.
items.zh: 雖然這個計畫很冒險，最後卻得到了不錯的回報。

items.sentence: The lost dog was found waiting quietly near the school gate.
items.zh: 那隻走失的狗被發現安靜地在校門口附近等著。

items.sentence: She would have joined us if her parents had allowed it.
items.zh: 要是她父母允許，她就會來加入我們了。

items.sentence: Eating too much sugar at night can disturb your sleep.
items.zh: 晚上吃太多糖可能會干擾你的睡眠。

items.sentence: The company has been offering free classes to local students.
items.zh: 這家公司一直在為當地學生提供免費課程。

items.sentence: I would rather walk to school than sit in heavy traffic.
items.zh: 我寧願走路上學，也不想困在嚴重的塞車裡。

items.sentence: The decision was made while the committee was still debating.
items.zh: 這個決定是在委員會還在辯論的時候做出的。

items.sentence: Not only was the meal delicious, but the service was excellent.
items.zh: 這頓飯不但好吃，服務也非常棒。

items.sentence: Had she practiced more, she would have won the spelling bee.
items.zh: 要是她多練習一點，就會贏得拼字比賽了。

items.sentence: Community gardens give neighbors a shared space to grow vegetables.
items.zh: 社區花園讓鄰居們有個共同的空間可以種菜。

items.sentence: The essay was corrected carefully before it was handed in.
items.zh: 這篇作文在交出去之前經過了仔細修改。

items.sentence: He missed the bus because he had forgotten to set an alarm.
items.zh: 他錯過了公車，因為他忘了設鬧鐘。

items.sentence: The harder she worked, the prouder her family became of her.
items.zh: 她越努力，家人就越以她為榮。

items.sentence: Warm meals are served to the elderly every afternoon here.
items.zh: 這裡每天下午都會為長者供應熱騰騰的餐點。

items.sentence: Even if the budget is small, the project can still succeed.
items.zh: 即使預算不多，這個計畫仍然可以成功。

items.sentence: They have been recycling bottles so that less plastic is wasted.
items.zh: 他們一直在回收瓶子，好讓更少的塑膠被浪費掉。

items.sentence: The empty warehouse has been turned into a youth center.
items.zh: 那間空蕩蕩的倉庫已經被改造成青少年活動中心。

items.sentence: Kind words, though simple, can brighten someone's whole day.
items.zh: 親切的話語雖然簡單，卻能照亮某個人的一整天。

items.sentence: By next spring, she will have taught here for ten years.
items.zh: 到明年春天，她就在這裡教書滿十年了。

items.sentence: Walking in sunlight has been shown to boost our energy.
items.zh: 研究顯示，在陽光下散步能提升我們的活力。

items.sentence: The ancient castle has stood on that hill for centuries.
items.zh: 那座古堡已經矗立在那座山丘上好幾個世紀了。

items.sentence: Although traffic was heavy, we still reached the airport on time.
items.zh: 雖然路上很塞，我們還是準時抵達了機場。

items.sentence: Her phone had died before she could send the final message.
items.zh: 在她能發出最後一則訊息之前，手機就沒電了。

items.sentence: Fresh air and sunlight are known to improve our daily mood.
items.zh: 大家都知道新鮮空氣和陽光能改善我們每天的心情。

items.sentence: The classrooms are cleaned thoroughly before the new term starts.
items.zh: 這些教室在新學期開始前都會被徹底打掃乾淨。

items.sentence: He has been collecting stamps ever since he was a child.
items.zh: 他從小時候起就一直在收集郵票。

items.sentence: Rarely had the town seen such a huge crowd downtown.
items.zh: 這座小鎮很少在市中心見到這麼龐大的人群。

items.sentence: While paper maps are fading, many hikers still trust them.
items.zh: 雖然紙本地圖正逐漸式微，許多登山者仍然信賴它們。

items.sentence: The old theater is being restored to its former beauty.
items.zh: 這間老戲院正在被修復，恢復昔日的美麗。

items.sentence: Even though the hill was steep, the view was worth it.
items.zh: 雖然這座山坡很陡，眼前的景色卻值得這一切。

items.sentence: Healthy habits formed early tend to last a whole lifetime.
items.zh: 從小養成的健康習慣往往能維持一輩子。

items.sentence: The announcement was repeated twice so that everyone could hear it.
items.zh: 這則通知重複播了兩次，好讓每個人都能聽到。

items.sentence: No sooner had the bell rung than the students rushed out.
items.zh: 鐘聲一響，學生們就衝了出去。

items.sentence: Reducing food waste at home can save a family real money.
items.zh: 減少家中的食物浪費能為一個家庭省下不少錢。

items.sentence: The documents were kept safe until the owner returned home.
items.zh: 這些文件被妥善保管，直到物主回到家。

items.sentence: She studies hard, which is why her teachers trust her.
items.zh: 她很用功，這就是老師信任她的原因。

items.sentence: If we had planted the seeds sooner, they would be blooming now.
items.zh: 如果我們早點把種子種下，現在它們就已經在開花了。

items.sentence: Many old crafts are slowly being forgotten in modern cities.
items.zh: 許多古老的手工藝在現代城市裡正慢慢被遺忘。

items.sentence: The bridge is inspected regularly to keep travelers safe.
items.zh: 這座橋會定期接受檢查，以確保旅客的安全。

items.sentence: He has been saving part of his allowance for a telescope.
items.zh: 他一直把一部分零用錢存起來，想買一台望遠鏡。

items.sentence: Although the test was tough, most students passed it easily.
items.zh: 雖然這場考試很難，大多數學生還是輕鬆通過了。

items.sentence: The contract had been signed before anyone read the fine print.
items.zh: 在任何人讀到那些細小的條款之前，合約就已經簽好了。

items.sentence: Our flight was delayed because the runway was being repaired.
items.zh: 我們的班機誤點了，因為跑道正在維修。

items.sentence: She has been training every morning to qualify for the marathon.
items.zh: 她每天早上都在訓練，為了取得馬拉松的參賽資格。

items.sentence: Although the recipe called for butter, we used olive oil instead.
items.zh: 雖然這份食譜需要奶油，我們卻改用了橄欖油。

items.sentence: Had the pilot not reacted quickly, the landing could have failed.
items.zh: 要不是機師反應迅速，這次降落可能就失敗了。

items.sentence: The volunteers had cleaned the beach long before the tourists arrived.
items.zh: 早在遊客抵達之前，志工們就已經把海灘清理乾淨了。

items.sentence: Most of the furniture here was made by local craftsmen.
items.zh: 這裡大部分的家具都是當地工匠製作的。

items.sentence: Even though he apologized sincerely, the damage had already been done.
items.zh: 儘管他誠懇地道了歉，傷害卻已經造成了。

items.sentence: If the river were cleaner, more fish would survive here.
items.zh: 如果這條河更乾淨，就會有更多魚在這裡存活。

items.sentence: The scientists have been analyzing the samples for several weeks.
items.zh: 科學家們已經分析這些樣本好幾個星期了。

items.sentence: Rarely have I met someone so patient with young children.
items.zh: 我很少遇到對幼童這麼有耐心的人。

items.sentence: The museum's oldest painting is being cleaned by an expert team.
items.zh: 這座博物館最古老的畫作正由一支專家團隊清理。

items.sentence: Whereas the north of the country is dry, the south is humid.
items.zh: 這個國家的北部很乾燥，南部卻很潮濕。

items.sentence: She would have accepted the offer if it had come sooner.
items.zh: 要是這個提議早點來，她就會接受了。

items.sentence: By the end of July, they will have painted the entire fence.
items.zh: 到七月底，他們就會把整道圍籬都漆好了。

items.sentence: The broken elevator has been out of service since Tuesday morning.
items.zh: 那部故障的電梯從星期二早上起就一直停用。

items.sentence: Although the medicine tasted bitter, it cured her cough quickly.
items.zh: 雖然這種藥很苦，卻很快治好了她的咳嗽。

items.sentence: The witnesses were questioned carefully before the trial began.
items.zh: 在審判開始之前，證人們都被仔細地詢問過了。

items.sentence: He has been saving old newspapers to recycle them properly.
items.zh: 他一直在收集舊報紙，好把它們妥善回收。

items.sentence: No sooner had we sat down than the lights went out.
items.zh: 我們才剛坐下，燈就熄了。

items.sentence: If I had taken that job, I would be living abroad now.
items.zh: 如果我當初接下那份工作，現在就會住在國外了。

items.sentence: The ancient manuscripts are kept in a room with controlled temperature.
items.zh: 這些古老的手稿被保存在一個控溫的房間裡。

items.sentence: Despite the warning signs, several hikers ignored the closed trail.
items.zh: 儘管有警告標誌，還是有幾名登山者無視了封閉的步道。

items.sentence: The orchestra had been rehearsing for hours when the conductor arrived.
items.zh: 指揮抵達時，管弦樂團已經排練好幾個小時了。

items.sentence: Our neighborhood association plans to plant trees along every street.
items.zh: 我們的社區協會打算在每條街道旁種樹。

items.sentence: The bridge will be reopened once the safety checks are complete.
items.zh: 等安全檢查完成後，這座橋就會重新開放。

items.sentence: However clever the plan seemed, it relied on perfect weather.
items.zh: 無論這個計畫看起來多聰明，它都仰賴完美的天氣。

items.sentence: She has been teaching herself to code during her free evenings.
items.zh: 她一直利用晚上的空閒時間自學寫程式。

items.sentence: The stolen bicycle was returned to its owner within two days.
items.zh: 那輛被偷的腳踏車在兩天內就歸還給物主了。

items.sentence: Although they had rehearsed well, the actors still felt nervous backstage.
items.zh: 雖然他們排練得很好，演員們在後台還是感到緊張。

items.sentence: The water supply had been cut off before we noticed the leak.
items.zh: 在我們注意到漏水之前，供水就已經被切斷了。

items.sentence: If prices keep rising, many families will struggle to save money.
items.zh: 如果物價持續上漲，許多家庭將難以存錢。

items.sentence: The vaccines are stored in freezers to keep them effective.
items.zh: 這些疫苗被儲存在冷凍庫裡，以維持它們的效力。

items.sentence: Not until the storm passed did the rescue teams reach the village.
items.zh: 直到暴風雨過去，救援隊才抵達那座村莊。

items.sentence: He has been collecting donations so that the shelter can expand.
items.zh: 他一直在募集捐款，好讓這間收容所能夠擴建。

items.sentence: Whereas my father reads slowly, my mother finishes a book overnight.
items.zh: 我父親讀書很慢，我母親卻能一夜讀完一本書。

items.sentence: The old recipes had been passed down through many generations.
items.zh: 這些古老的食譜經過許多世代流傳了下來。

items.sentence: Even though the ticket price doubled, the fans kept buying seats.
items.zh: 即使票價翻倍，粉絲們還是不斷買票。

items.sentence: The laptops are updated automatically whenever a new version appears.
items.zh: 每當有新版本推出時，這些筆電就會自動更新。

items.sentence: If she had remembered the password, we could have logged in.
items.zh: 要是她記得密碼，我們就能登入了。

items.sentence: The injured player has been recovering steadily since the operation.
items.zh: 那名受傷的球員自手術以來一直穩定地復原。

items.sentence: Seldom does the mail arrive before noon in this town.
items.zh: 在這個小鎮，郵件很少在中午前送達。

items.sentence: The abandoned mine is being explored by a group of scientists.
items.zh: 那座廢棄的礦坑正由一群科學家探勘。

items.sentence: Although the road looked empty, drivers were warned to slow down.
items.zh: 雖然這條路看起來空蕩蕩的，駕駛仍被提醒要放慢速度。

items.sentence: By the time the alarm sounded, the thieves had already escaped.
items.zh: 警報響起時，竊賊早已逃走了。

items.sentence: The crops are watered at dawn to avoid the midday heat.
items.zh: 這些作物在黎明時澆水，以避開正午的高溫。

items.sentence: He has been practicing the violin since he was five years old.
items.zh: 他從五歲起就一直在練小提琴。

items.sentence: If we had reserved a table, we would not be waiting outside.
items.zh: 要是我們訂了位，就不會在外面等了。

items.sentence: The streets were lined with flags for the national holiday.
items.zh: 街道兩旁為了國定假日掛滿了旗幟。

items.sentence: Despite losing the first round, the team went on to win.
items.zh: 儘管輸了第一回合，這支隊伍最後還是贏了。

items.sentence: The reports had been filed incorrectly, so nobody could find them.
items.zh: 這些報告被歸檔錯誤，所以沒有人能找到它們。

items.sentence: The garden is watered twice daily during the hottest months.
items.zh: 在最炎熱的那幾個月，這座花園每天澆水兩次。

items.sentence: Only after the exam did she realize how simple it was.
items.zh: 直到考完試，她才明白那有多簡單。

items.sentence: The volunteers have been sorting clothes for the families in need.
items.zh: 志工們一直在為有需要的家庭分類衣物。

items.sentence: Although the engine was old, the mechanic got it running again.
items.zh: 雖然引擎很舊，技工還是讓它重新運轉了起來。

items.sentence: The letters had been hidden in the attic for over fifty years.
items.zh: 這些信件在閣樓裡被藏了超過五十年。

items.sentence: If the weather improves, the outdoor concert will not be moved.
items.zh: 如果天氣好轉，這場戶外音樂會就不會改到別處。

items.sentence: The paintings are protected from sunlight by thick curtains.
items.zh: 這些畫作靠著厚厚的窗簾免受陽光照射。

items.sentence: She has been keeping a diary ever since her first trip abroad.
items.zh: 自從第一次出國旅行後，她就一直在寫日記。

items.sentence: Never had the audience applauded so loudly for a young singer.
items.zh: 觀眾從未為一位年輕歌手鼓掌得這麼熱烈過。

items.sentence: The ancient wall is being studied by historians from many countries.
items.zh: 這道古老的城牆正由來自許多國家的歷史學家研究。

items.sentence: Whereas some prefer tea, my grandfather drinks only black coffee.
items.zh: 有些人偏好喝茶，我祖父卻只喝黑咖啡。

items.sentence: He would have missed the ceremony if the bus had not come.
items.zh: 要是公車沒來，他就會錯過典禮了。

items.sentence: By next winter, the workers will have finished the new tunnel.
items.zh: 到明年冬天，工人們就會完成這條新隧道了。

items.sentence: The factory has been switching to cleaner energy over recent years.
items.zh: 近幾年來，這間工廠一直在轉用更乾淨的能源。

items.sentence: Although the puzzle looked easy, it fooled even the experts.
items.zh: 雖然這個謎題看起來很簡單，卻連專家都被難倒了。

items.sentence: The room had been decorated beautifully before the guests walked in.
items.zh: 在賓客走進來之前，這個房間就已經布置得很漂亮了。

items.sentence: Clean energy is being adopted faster than many people expected.
items.zh: 乾淨能源的採用速度比許多人預期的還要快。

items.sentence: Hardly had the race started when the leader slipped on the mud.
items.zh: 比賽才剛開始，領先者就在泥地上滑倒了。

items.sentence: If I had trusted my first answer, I would have scored higher.
items.zh: 要是我相信自己最初的答案，就會考得更高分了。

items.sentence: The historic theater has been restored with great care and patience.
items.zh: 這座歷史悠久的劇院被極其用心又耐心地修復了。

items.sentence: Despite the long line, the customers waited patiently for fresh bread.
items.zh: 儘管排了長長的隊伍，顧客們仍耐心地等待新鮮的麵包。

items.sentence: The negotiations had collapsed before the two sides could agree.
items.zh: 在雙方能達成共識之前，談判就已經破局了。

items.sentence: Water from the mountains is piped down to the farms below.
items.zh: 來自山上的水被管線引到下方的農田。

items.sentence: She has been mentoring younger students throughout the whole semester.
items.zh: 整個學期以來，她一直在指導比較年幼的學生。

items.sentence: Only when the music stopped did the dancers finally rest.
items.zh: 直到音樂停下，舞者們才終於休息。

items.sentence: The rare books are handled only with clean cotton gloves.
items.zh: 這些珍本書只能戴著乾淨的棉質手套翻閱。

items.sentence: Although the budget was tight, they refused to lower their standards.
items.zh: 雖然預算很緊，他們還是拒絕降低自己的標準。

items.sentence: The passengers had been waiting for an hour when the gate opened.
items.zh: 登機門打開時，乘客們已經等了一個小時。

items.sentence: If more people cycled to work, the air would be cleaner.
items.zh: 如果有更多人騎單車上班，空氣就會更乾淨。

items.sentence: The results are checked twice before any grades are released.
items.zh: 在任何成績公布之前，結果都會被檢查兩次。

items.sentence: Not once had he complained about the long hours at work.
items.zh: 他從來沒有抱怨過工作時間太長。

items.sentence: The flooded fields are being drained by powerful new pumps.
items.zh: 這些淹水的田地正由強力的新型抽水機排水。

items.sentence: Whereas cities grow noisier each year, the valley stays peaceful.
items.zh: 城市一年比一年吵雜，這座山谷卻依然寧靜。

items.sentence: She would have warned us if she had sensed any danger.
items.zh: 要是她察覺到任何危險，就會提醒我們了。

items.sentence: By the time the guests left, the host had cleared every plate.
items.zh: 賓客離開時，主人已經收走了每一個盤子。

items.sentence: The charity has been feeding hundreds of people every single week.
items.zh: 這個慈善機構每週都在供應數百人飲食。

items.sentence: Although the instructions were long, the project was surprisingly simple.
items.zh: 雖然說明書很長，這個專案卻意外地簡單。

items.sentence: The tickets had sold out before the box office even opened.
items.zh: 在售票口開門之前，門票就已經賣光了。

items.sentence: Old photographs are scanned carefully so the memories are not lost.
items.zh: 舊照片被仔細掃描，好讓那些回憶不至於遺失。

items.sentence: Little did we know that the quiet valley hid a waterfall.
items.zh: 我們當時完全不知道，這座寧靜的山谷裡藏著一道瀑布。

items.sentence: If the teacher had explained slowly, more students would have understood.
items.zh: 要是老師講解得慢一點，就會有更多學生聽懂了。

items.sentence: The historic engine has been carefully restored by skilled volunteers.
items.zh: 這具歷史悠久的引擎被技術純熟的志工們細心修復了。

items.sentence: Despite the heavy snow, the postal workers delivered every parcel.
items.zh: 儘管下著大雪，郵務人員還是送達了每一個包裹。

items.sentence: The power had gone out before the engineers could fix the fault.
items.zh: 在工程師能修好故障之前，電力就已經中斷了。

items.sentence: Fresh herbs are grown on the roof to supply the kitchen.
items.zh: 新鮮的香草種在屋頂上，供應廚房使用。

items.sentence: She has been managing the whole project while her boss recovers.
items.zh: 在老闆養病期間，她一直在管理整個專案。

items.sentence: Only through hard practice did the choir reach such a high standard.
items.zh: 正是透過刻苦的練習，這個合唱團才達到如此高的水準。

items.sentence: The rescued animals are being fed and examined by the staff.
items.zh: 這些獲救的動物正由工作人員餵食和檢查。

items.sentence: Although the hill was steep, the cyclists refused to give up.
items.zh: 雖然山坡很陡，單車騎士們還是不肯放棄。

items.sentence: The ship had sailed away before the storm reached the harbor.
items.zh: 在暴風雨抵達港口之前，這艘船就已經駛離了。

items.sentence: If we recycled more glass, fewer bottles would reach the dump.
items.zh: 如果我們多回收玻璃，就會有更少的瓶子進入垃圾場。

items.sentence: The classrooms are heated gently during the coldest winter weeks.
items.zh: 在最寒冷的那幾週冬天，這些教室會輕輕地供暖。

items.sentence: Never before had the river risen so high in living memory.
items.zh: 在人們的記憶中，這條河從未漲得這麼高過。

items.sentence: The flooded basement is being pumped out by the fire crew.
items.zh: 那間淹水的地下室正由消防隊抽水排空。

items.sentence: Whereas the morning class was quiet, the afternoon one was lively.
items.zh: 早上的那堂課很安靜，下午的那堂課卻很熱鬧。

items.sentence: He would have joined the army if his health had allowed it.
items.zh: 要是他的身體狀況允許，他就會從軍了。

items.sentence: By the end of the course, you will have written four essays.
items.zh: 到課程結束時，你就會寫完四篇作文了。

items.sentence: The small bakery has been supplying bread to the school for years.
items.zh: 這家小麵包店多年來一直供應麵包給這所學校。

items.sentence: Although the signal was weak, the climbers managed to call for help.
items.zh: 雖然訊號很弱，登山者還是成功呼叫到了救援。

items.sentence: The seeds had already sprouted before the gardener returned from vacation.
items.zh: 在園丁度假回來之前，種子就已經發芽了。

items.sentence: Rare coins are displayed behind thick glass to prevent theft.
items.zh: 稀有的錢幣被陳列在厚玻璃後方，以防遭竊。

items.sentence: She has been coaching the junior team with great energy this season.
items.zh: 這個球季她一直充滿活力地指導青少年隊。

items.sentence: Not only had the roof leaked, but the walls had cracked too.
items.zh: 不但屋頂漏水，就連牆壁也裂開了。

items.sentence: The data is backed up nightly so that nothing is ever lost.
items.zh: 這些資料每晚都會備份，好讓任何東西都不會遺失。

items.sentence: If the lake had frozen solid, we could have skated across it.
items.zh: 要是這座湖凍得夠結實，我們就能溜冰越過它了。

items.sentence: The ancient scrolls have been examined by scholars from distant universities.
items.zh: 這些古老的卷軸被來自遙遠大學的學者們檢視過了。

items.sentence: Despite the strong wind, the kite stayed high above the field.
items.zh: 儘管風很強，風箏仍高高地停在田野上空。

items.sentence: The money had been donated anonymously before the campaign even started.
items.zh: 早在這場活動開始之前，這筆錢就已經匿名捐出了。

items.sentence: Fresh fruit is handed out to the children after every practice.
items.zh: 每次練習結束後，都會發新鮮水果給孩子們。

items.sentence: The contract will be signed as soon as both sides agree.
items.zh: 等雙方都同意後，這份合約就會被簽署。

items.sentence: She has been waiting outside the clinic since early this morning.
items.zh: 她從今天一大早就一直在診所外面等著。

items.sentence: By the time the rain stopped, we had missed the ferry.
items.zh: 等雨停的時候，我們已經錯過了渡輪。

items.sentence: Although the apartment was small, it felt warm and welcoming.
items.zh: 雖然這間公寓很小，卻讓人感覺溫暖又親切。

items.sentence: The new rules are being explained to every employee this week.
items.zh: 這週正在向每一位員工說明這些新規定。

items.sentence: If I had known the road was closed, I would have driven around.
items.zh: 要是我知道這條路封了，我就會繞道開了。

items.sentence: He has been teaching night classes while finishing his own degree.
items.zh: 他一邊修完自己的學位，一邊一直在教夜間課程。

items.sentence: The ancient coins had been buried under the field for centuries.
items.zh: 這些古老的錢幣在田地底下被埋了好幾個世紀。

items.sentence: Even though the price rose sharply, customers kept ordering the dish.
items.zh: 即使價格大幅上漲，顧客還是不斷點這道菜。

items.sentence: Whereas my sister enjoys crowds, I feel calmer in quiet places.
items.zh: 我妹妹喜歡人多的地方，我在安靜的地方卻比較平靜。

items.sentence: The broken fence is being replaced by a team of volunteers.
items.zh: 那道壞掉的圍籬正由一群志工更換。

items.sentence: If she were taller, she could reach the top shelf easily.
items.zh: 如果她再高一點，就能輕鬆搆到最上層的架子了。

items.sentence: They have been collecting warm coats for families through the winter.
items.zh: 整個冬天他們一直在為各個家庭募集保暖的外套。

items.sentence: The letters had already been mailed before she changed her mind.
items.zh: 在她改變主意之前，那些信件就已經被寄出去了。

items.sentence: Despite the long delay, the passengers stayed surprisingly calm and polite.
items.zh: 儘管延誤了很久，乘客們仍意外地保持冷靜又有禮。

items.sentence: The samples are tested twice before any product leaves the factory.
items.zh: 每樣產品出廠前，樣本都會被檢測兩次。

items.sentence: Rarely had the coach seen a player improve so quickly.
items.zh: 教練很少見過一名球員進步得這麼快。

items.sentence: If we had left at dawn, we would be at the lake now.
items.zh: 要是我們天亮就出發，現在就會在湖邊了。

items.sentence: The old clock has been ticking in that hallway for decades.
items.zh: 那座老時鐘在那條走廊裡已經滴答走了數十年。

items.sentence: Although the exam was hard, he felt oddly calm throughout it.
items.zh: 雖然這場考試很難，他從頭到尾卻異常冷靜。

items.sentence: The injured hiker was carried down the trail by two rescuers.
items.zh: 那名受傷的登山者由兩名救援人員抬下步道。

items.sentence: She has been painting the old shed a soft shade of gray.
items.zh: 她一直在把那間舊棚子漆成柔和的灰色。

items.sentence: By next fall, the students will have planted a hundred trees.
items.zh: 到明年秋天，學生們就會種下一百棵樹了。

items.sentence: The leaking pipe had flooded the kitchen before anyone noticed.
items.zh: 在任何人注意到之前，漏水的水管就已經淹了廚房。

items.sentence: Even if the plan fails, we will have learned something valuable.
items.zh: 即使這個計畫失敗，我們也會學到一些寶貴的東西。

items.sentence: The donated toys are sorted carefully before they reach the children.
items.zh: 這些捐來的玩具在送到孩子手上之前會被仔細分類。

items.sentence: Had the driver slowed down, the accident might never have happened.
items.zh: 要是駕駛放慢速度，這場意外或許根本不會發生。

items.sentence: He has been saving every receipt so that he can budget better.
items.zh: 他一直把每張收據留著，好讓自己能更好地規劃預算。

items.sentence: Whereas the old model was noisy, the new one runs quietly.
items.zh: 舊的機型很吵，新的機型運轉起來卻很安靜。

items.sentence: The garden had been neglected for years before she moved in.
items.zh: 在她搬進來之前，這座花園已經荒廢了好幾年。

items.sentence: If I were offered the job, I would move to another city.
items.zh: 如果有人把這份工作給我，我就會搬到另一座城市。

items.sentence: The streets are swept before the farmers set up their stalls.
items.zh: 在農夫們擺設攤位之前，街道就會被清掃乾淨。

items.sentence: Never had the little theater sold so many tickets in one night.
items.zh: 這間小劇院從未在一個晚上賣出這麼多張票。

items.sentence: She has been studying late so that she can retake the test.
items.zh: 她一直熬夜讀書，好讓自己能重考這場測驗。

items.sentence: Although the soup looked plain, it tasted rich and comforting.
items.zh: 雖然這碗湯看起來很樸素，喝起來卻濃郁又暖心。

items.sentence: The missing wallet was handed in to the station by a stranger.
items.zh: 那個遺失的皮夾被一名陌生人交到了車站。

items.sentence: If he had read the fine print, he would have canceled the order.
items.zh: 要是他讀了那些細小的條款，就會取消這筆訂單了。

items.sentence: The old mill has been grinding flour for over two hundred years.
items.zh: 這座老磨坊已經磨了兩百多年的麵粉。

items.sentence: Despite feeling exhausted, the nurses finished every shift without complaint.
items.zh: 儘管疲憊不堪，護理師們還是毫無怨言地做完了每一個班。

items.sentence: The report had been rewritten twice before the manager approved it.
items.zh: 在經理核准之前，這份報告已經被重寫了兩次。

items.sentence: Seldom do we get a chance to thank the people behind the scenes.
items.zh: 我們很少有機會去感謝那些幕後的人。

items.sentence: She has been keeping the shop open even on the slowest days.
items.zh: 即使在生意最清淡的日子，她也一直讓店開著。

items.sentence: If the bridge were wider, the morning traffic would move faster.
items.zh: 如果這座橋更寬，早晨的車流就會更順暢。

items.sentence: The flowers are watered at dusk to help them survive the heat.
items.zh: 這些花在黃昏時澆水，以幫助它們熬過高溫。

items.sentence: Only after the lights dimmed did the audience finally fall silent.
items.zh: 直到燈光變暗，觀眾才終於安靜下來。

items.sentence: The ancient map had been folded so tightly that it nearly tore.
items.zh: 這張古地圖被折得太緊，差點就撕破了。

items.sentence: Although the recipe was simple, the flavors blended beautifully together.
items.zh: 雖然這份食譜很簡單，各種味道卻完美地融合在一起。

items.sentence: The stray cat has been sleeping on our porch for a week.
items.zh: 那隻流浪貓已經在我們的門廊上睡了一個星期。

items.sentence: If she had saved earlier, she would own a small apartment today.
items.zh: 要是她早點存錢，今天就會擁有一間小公寓了。

items.sentence: The rare manuscript is kept in a case that controls humidity.
items.zh: 這份珍貴的手稿被保存在一個能控制濕度的櫃子裡。

items.sentence: Little did they realize how long the repairs would actually take.
items.zh: 他們當時完全沒料到這些維修實際上要花這麼久。

items.sentence: He has been learning sign language to talk with his new neighbor.
items.zh: 他一直在學手語，好和他的新鄰居交談。

items.sentence: Whereas plastic bags are banned here, paper ones are still allowed.
items.zh: 塑膠袋在這裡被禁用，紙袋卻仍然被允許。

items.sentence: The crops had withered before the first rain finally arrived.
items.zh: 在第一場雨終於到來之前，作物就已經枯萎了。

items.sentence: By the time we reached the summit, the clouds had cleared completely.
items.zh: 等我們抵達山頂時，雲已經完全散開了。

items.sentence: The old recipes are being collected before the elders forget them.
items.zh: 這些古老的食譜正趁著長輩還沒忘記之前被蒐集起來。

items.sentence: If the alarm had not rung, the family might have slept through the fire.
items.zh: 要不是警報響了，這家人可能就在火災中睡過頭了。

items.sentence: She has been volunteering at the hospital on her days off.
items.zh: 她一直利用自己的休假日在醫院當志工。

items.sentence: Although the journey was long, nobody wanted it to end.
items.zh: 雖然這趟旅程很漫長，卻沒有人希望它結束。

items.sentence: The flooded road is being cleared by workers in bright jackets.
items.zh: 那條淹水的道路正由穿著亮色外套的工人清理。

items.sentence: Had we checked the weather, we would have packed warmer clothes.
items.zh: 要是我們查過天氣，就會帶更保暖的衣服了。

items.sentence: The gentle horse is trusted even by the youngest riders here.
items.zh: 這匹溫馴的馬連這裡最年幼的騎手都信任。

items.sentence: By next month, she will have finished reading the whole series.
items.zh: 到下個月，她就會把整個系列都讀完了。

items.sentence: The paintings had faded badly before the museum began restoring them.
items.zh: 在博物館開始修復之前，這些畫作就已經嚴重褪色了。

items.sentence: If the soil were richer, these plants would grow much taller.
items.zh: 如果土壤更肥沃，這些植物就會長得高很多。

items.sentence: The homemade jam is sold out within hours every single Saturday.
items.zh: 每個星期六，這款自製果醬都在幾個小時內就賣光。

items.sentence: Not once has she been late since she moved closer to work.
items.zh: 自從她搬到離公司更近的地方，就從沒遲到過。

items.sentence: He has been repairing bicycles for the children in his free time.
items.zh: 他一直利用空閒時間為孩子們修理腳踏車。

items.sentence: Although the storm was fierce, the little boat reached the shore safely.
items.zh: 雖然暴風雨很猛烈，那艘小船還是安全地抵達了岸邊。

items.sentence: The damaged road signs are being replaced throughout the whole district.
items.zh: 整個轄區內受損的路標正在被更換。

items.sentence: If I had my own garden, I would grow tomatoes and herbs.
items.zh: 如果我有自己的花園，我會種番茄和香草。

items.sentence: The classroom had been rearranged before the students walked back in.
items.zh: 在學生們走回來之前，這間教室就已經重新布置過了。

items.sentence: Only through steady practice did he finally master the difficult piece.
items.zh: 正是透過穩定的練習，他才終於精通了這首難曲。

items.sentence: She has been mending old clothes rather than throwing them away.
items.zh: 她一直在縫補舊衣服，而不是把它們丟掉。

items.sentence: Whereas the city floods often, the hilltop village stays perfectly dry.
items.zh: 城市經常淹水，山頂上的村莊卻一直保持乾爽。

items.sentence: The old engine had stalled twice before the mechanic found the fault.
items.zh: 在技工找到故障之前，這具老引擎已經熄火兩次了。

items.sentence: By the time dinner was ready, the guests had already gone home.
items.zh: 等晚餐準備好時，客人們已經回家了。

items.sentence: The rescued puppies are being fed small meals throughout the day.
items.zh: 這些獲救的小狗一整天都被分成小份餵食。

items.sentence: Had the team listened to the warning, the project would have survived.
items.zh: 要是這個團隊聽了那個警告，這個專案就能保住了。

items.sentence: He has been cycling to work to save money on gas.
items.zh: 他一直騎單車上班，好省下汽油的開銷。

items.sentence: Although the loan was approved, the family decided not to borrow.
items.zh: 雖然這筆貸款獲准了，這家人還是決定不借。

items.sentence: The fresh paint is left to dry overnight before the doors open.
items.zh: 油漆會放著乾一整夜，門才會打開。

items.sentence: Rarely does a quiet town attract so many curious visitors.
items.zh: 一個寧靜的小鎮很少吸引到這麼多好奇的訪客。

items.sentence: She has been recording birdsong in the forest every spring morning.
items.zh: 每個春天的早晨，她都一直在森林裡錄製鳥鳴。

items.sentence: If the ticket were cheaper, far more families could attend the show.
items.zh: 如果票價更便宜，就會有更多家庭能來看這場表演。

items.sentence: The water tanks had been emptied before the long drought began.
items.zh: 在那場漫長的乾旱開始之前，水箱就已經被放空了。

items.sentence: Despite the thick fog, the pilot landed the plane without trouble.
items.zh: 儘管濃霧瀰漫，機師還是毫無困難地讓飛機降落了。

items.sentence: The overdue books are returned quietly through the slot by the door.
items.zh: 這些逾期的書被悄悄地從門邊的投遞口還了回來。

items.sentence: Only when the price dropped did the shoppers begin to buy.
items.zh: 直到價格下降，購物者才開始購買。

items.sentence: He has been growing vegetables on the balcony of his apartment.
items.zh: 他一直在自己公寓的陽台上種蔬菜。

items.sentence: Although the lecture ran late, not a single student left early.
items.zh: 雖然這場講座超時了，卻沒有一個學生提早離開。

items.sentence: The worn carpets are being replaced before the new tenants arrive.
items.zh: 在新房客抵達之前，這些磨損的地毯正在被更換。

items.sentence: If she had trusted her instincts, she would have taken that path.
items.zh: 要是她相信自己的直覺，就會選那條路了。

items.sentence: The ancient bells had rung every hour until the war silenced them.
items.zh: 這些古老的鐘每個小時都會敲響，直到戰爭讓它們沉寂。

items.sentence: By the end of summer, he will have saved enough for a camera.
items.zh: 到夏天結束時，他就會存夠錢買一台相機了。

items.sentence: The donated blood is screened carefully before it is ever used.
items.zh: 這些捐出的血液在被使用之前都會被仔細篩檢。

items.sentence: Never before had the villagers gathered so eagerly for a meeting.
items.zh: 村民們從未這麼熱切地聚集起來開會過。

items.sentence: She has been coaching the debate club without any pay this year.
items.zh: 今年她一直無償指導辯論社。

items.sentence: Although the ladder looked unsteady, the painter climbed it confidently.
items.zh: 雖然這把梯子看起來不穩，油漆工還是自信地爬了上去。

items.sentence: The old photographs had yellowed before anyone thought to protect them.
items.zh: 在有人想到要保護之前，這些舊照片就已經泛黃了。
